WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia is authorized by O.C.G.A. § 36-66-1 et seq, and the Town Charter, to exercise its police power to enact and amend a zoning ordinance for land use regulations as to property within the Town of Clermont,

Georgia; and

WHEREAS, on March 14, 1997, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia duly enacted the Planing and Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, and being designated as Ordinance No. 97-01, and from time to time, has amended said ordinance; and

WHEREAS, Section 7.2.E. of the zoning ordinance allows the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, to amend the official land use map of the Town of Clermont, from time to time; and

WHEREAS, since the date of the original enactment of the zoning ordinance, the Town Counce] of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, has amended the official land use map of the Town of Clermont, Georgia several times, and for clarity purposes, and for all zoning purposes allowed under law, the Town Council finds that it is appropriate in accordance with the provisions of said ordinance, to adopt a new official land use map as referred to in Article VII of the Land Use Ordinance (zoning ordinance) of the Town of Clermont, Georgia; and

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by the above-referenced authority, as follows:
